scripts.dev:db: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local.yaml up -d postgres
scripts.docker:local:migrate: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.local.yaml exec api npm run migration:run:prod
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zevooria/api && npm run build -w @zevooria/web && npm run build -w @zevooria/admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @zevooria/api -- --runInBand --forceExit && npm run test -w @zevooria/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zevooria/api && npm run typecheck -w @zevooria/web && npm run typecheck -w @zevooria/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @zevooria/api && npm run lint -w @zevooria/web && npm run lint -w @zevooria/admin
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
